title: Jason Oppenheim Nets $210,000 Commission In $7 Million Sale of Orlando Bloom’s Beverly Hills Home
htmlContent:
Jason Oppenheim owns the Oppenheim Group and is one of the most well-known figures in luxury real estate.

On season 8, episode 3 of the popular Netflix series Selling Sunset, he celebrated an essential achievement in his career. Oppenheim announced the sale of Orlando Bloom's Beverly Hills home for a staggering $7 million, ending a multi-year journey of leasing and managing the property.

This sale, which resulted in a handsome commission of $210,000, demonstrates his expertise in navigating the high-stakes world of luxury real estate and his perseverance in seeing through long-term investments. Oppenheim has been leasing Bloom's home for a few years, demonstrating his ability to maximize property value and maintain strong client relationships in a constantly changing market.

Bloom has owned the property, a modern gem in the coveted Beverly Hills area, since he purchased it in 2017 for $7 million. The home was a hit with A-list interest due to its open-plan design, state-of-the-art features, and breathtaking views. It was previously rented out to high-profile tenants under Oppenheim's guidance. Despite initial delays in finding the right buyer, Oppenheim's strategic home marketing approach eventually paid off.

Oppenheim's achievement in selling Bloom's house is a testament to his extensive understanding of the Los Angeles real estate market and the ability to close deals on properties with significant price points. His $210,000 commission, reflecting the standard 3% realtor fee, further underscores his achievements in the competitive luxury real estate market.

Bloom's home sale is another feather in Oppenheim's cap, but it also reminds us of his broader impact on the luxury real estate scene in Los Angeles. His role as the head of the Oppenheim Group keeps changing as he provides exceptional value to buyers and sellers, from multimillion-dollar homes to celebrity clients.

Selling Sunset continues to showcase luxury real estate's positive and negative aspects. 

Jason Oppenheim's recent victory is a testament to his business acumen and unwavering drive in one of the world's most competitive markets.
